EV-3 no longer retains a singular verified tree digest; it retains the signed TreeCommitment entry set in per-entry path/type/mode/length/digest form, which is both the repair I prescribed and the form live schemas.v11 explicitly chose over a root digest, and which file 04 line 150 independently warrants. treeRootDigest stays unpopulated and reserved. All 12 cited digests recompute, all five verbatim carries are character-exact against the live DR-G07 row, and the four evidence members rejoin to reproduce the live evidence cell exactly. All six dispatch attacks are refuted, including the two I pressed hardest independently: the six-member TCB filesystem identifierEnum does not refute the UNPOPULATED claim, because it is an open tagged vocabulary with an OTHER-FSTYPE escape and all four slice-1 profile stems stand RESERVED; and EV-2 does not drop file 04's canonical-serialization limb, it routes it to DR-103 and ID-DEP-1 where the live law already owns it. 32 attacks run, 32 refuted, 0 blockers, 0 MUST-FIX, 0 SHOULD-FIX.
